snippet.title: Vanya Online - Official Idle MMORPG Trailer
snippet.description:
Vanya Online is a dark free-to-play idle MMORPG set in a persistent online world with endless progression, PvP and Non-PvP worlds, player economy, events, boss hunts, rare loot, and no level cap.

Play for free:
https://vanyaonline.com

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4866960/Vanya_Online__Idle_MMORPG/

Official trailer produced by Somnix.

Music: “Vowed”
Composed by Pablo de Mello Heredia, created especially for Vanya Online and included in the Vanya Original Soundtrack.

Follow our composer:
https://found.ee/AlforriaPablo

Show No Mercy, Leave a Mark.

#VanyaOnline #IdleMMORPG #FreeToPlay #MMORPG #IndieGame
